set.body:
Defect: Placement: acquire's stated purpose is 'autonomous acquisition protocol: task packets, proposal-only agents, critics, resolution' (build.sbt:134) and it hosts a corpus parser.

Do: Move SherlockAnnotations to corpus-intake.

Tests: Safer than an earlier draft claimed: its only consumer is SherlockRecallMapping and its suite. FilmFestivalRecallMapping merely MENTIONS SherlockAnnotations at :27, in a Scaladoc explaining why it does NOT reuse it -- it is not a consumer. acquire's JS/Native builds lose nothing.

Exit: acquire holds only the agent protocol.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S3, P5
set.title: intake P5: migrate SherlockAnnotations out of acquire into corpus-intake
